name: Microgrid available-generation capacity estimator
summary: Combines declared resource availability and power limits into the selected generation capacity quantity.
description: Combines declared resource availability and power limits into the selected generation capacity quantity. Active-power dispatch allocates the electrical work performed by the microgrid resources. A total site target, a resource power limit and the actual measured contribution are different quantities that must be connected clearly in the diagram.

In a microgrid with solar generation, a battery and generators, the controller can allocate an import/export target among the available resources while reserving the power needed for operating disturbances. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Resource availability and limits” at the input and “Available generation estimate” at the output. An estimate is different from guaranteed delivered power.
